judged_text: The Disqus import was rewired through TopicEmbed.import_remote, silently dropping two behaviors of the previous path: the `--category/-c` CLI option was removed, and `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` is no longer passed, so imported topics are timestamped with import time. Operators running the documented `-c` flag get an unrecognized-option failure (or silently ignored option on some Thor versions), and all imported threads land in the default category with wrong dates — a contract break for existing import scripts whose data (chronological ordering, category placement) changes silently.

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the Thor option `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` from `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` and deletes the `category_id` lookup/use. It also replaces `PostCreator.new(... created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]), category: category_id)` with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and `TopicEmbed.import_remote`/`.import` do not accept or pass `created_at` or `category`. As a result, `-c` will now be an unrecognized option and imported topics/posts will be created with default category and current timestamps instead of the original thread dates—an observable behavior break introduced by this diff.
